name: smwmusic-chrono-trigger-last-battle
title: Chrono Trigger - Last Battle
description:
The tense song heard during Lavos' final phase in Chrono Trigger (Lavos' scream not included). It can fit boss fights or chase/escape sequences.
Special thanks to Yuzu for their PWM sample!

Note: not compatible with the "Bonus end" song or with Blarggs/thunder sfx.
